description: Least-privilege reader of a tenant's peer transport catalog (knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/connections/peer-network.json). libs/core/mesh/peer-conversation.ts assumes it, bound to the sending tenant, to resolve the recipient endpoint and HMAC secret, so peer senders whose role cannot read the confidential tier can still send; it grants that single file only and no write (persona worker). It is a tenant-bound reader (authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES): the bound tenant must be explicit and equal the caller's active tenant when one exists.
